title: Synthetic Eggs in Many Baskets: The Impact of Synthetic Data Diversity on LLM Fine-Tuning
reasoning: The paper investigates the impact of synthetic data diversity on LLM behavior, focusing on technical metrics like distribution collapse, self-preference bias, and safety/jailbreaking robustness. While it evaluates harmfulness relative to an Acceptable Use Policy, it does not explicitly study or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
